\begin{frame}{Annual services: scope and economics}

{\scriptsize Per fraction: online Compton red-light check, in-room PET within minutes, and AI analysis giving
a go/no-go for the next fraction, the distal edge, fraction statistics and updated coverage.
Data and models stay on local machines. An ARGOS specialist on site interprets results with the treating team, by tumour type.\par}
